decisions.reason: The IMU module sits at the core of the modular sensor platform, and its upgrade to a dedicated page in 2024 suggests results meet aspirations at low carrying cost from stocked components.
The industrial AC input module has had its own page in both years and features in a launch announcement, so it fits the firm's industrial direction and shows no shortfall that would trigger search.
The solid state relay module is a low-cost extension of the established relay line; only website mentions suggest modest results, but in-house production slack lets the firm carry it.
Launched only in 2024, the RGB LED module has too little evidence for a shortfall against aspirations, and modular in-house manufacturing makes keeping it cheap.
The wallbox remote access service supports the strategic expansion of charging and energy management, so management will keep investing in it despite limited early evidence.
